article.headline: AJ Barnes scores 19 to help Southern hold off Prairie View A&M 84-80
article.description: — AJ Barnes had 19 points to help Southern defeat Prairie View A&M 84-80 on Monday night.
article.linkText: AJ Barnes scores 19 to help Southern hold off Prairie View A&M 84-80
article.story: PRAIRIE VIEW, Texas -- — AJ Barnes had 19 points to help Southern defeat Prairie View A&M 84-80 on Monday night. Barnes also grabbed nine rebounds for the Jaguars (7-8, 2-0 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Derrick Tezeno scored 13 and Jordan Johnson added 11 points. The Panthers (2-13, 1-1) were led by Tanahj Pettway with 21 points. Orlando Horton Jr. added 20 points and four assists. Elijah Terry totaled with 13 points, three steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
